result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.label_propagation()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Semi-supervised label propagation for node classification. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L14311-L14382){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.label_propagation( known_labels, max_iter=100, attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Label propagation](/assets/graphs/label-propagation.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Two dense clusters, a triangle A, B, C and a four-node cluster D, E, F, G, joined by the edge C to D. Only A (id 1) and G (id 7) are given labels, 0 and 1, shown as badges; every other node adopts the label most common among its neighbors, so the triangle ends with label 0 (accent) and D, E, F, G with label 1 (teal)." width="100%"} Spreads known labels through the network: at each iteration every unlabeled node adopts the most common label among its neighbors (weighted by edge weight). Nodes whose labels are provided in `known_labels=` are held fixed throughout. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [known_labels]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[int, int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A `{node_id: label}` dictionary of seed labels. Labels are integers. At least one entry is required. [max_iter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of propagation iterations. [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the node attribute to store assignments. Defaults to `"label_propagation"`. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return a `{node_id: label}` dictionary directly. Otherwise store the result as a node attribute and return `self`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict or Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Label assignments for every node, or `self` for chaining. Nodes that could not be reached from any seed retain label `-1`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#010ca379 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") ) a_id = g.get_id_from_label("A") d_id = g.get_id_from_label("D") g.label_propagation({a_id: 0, d_id: 1}, return_dict=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {1: 0, 4: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1} ``` ::: :::
